name: Bakehouse
region: Bottom of the lane, beside the granary, sick village

sensoryProfile.sight: Low stone building with a chimney and a long brick oven built against its end, smoke brown and warm lying along the lane; a passage where Ellen stands behind Hob; at night dark, the oven raked out; at dawn the chimney cold.
sensoryProfile.smell: Scorched crust; heat still coming off the brick at dusk.
sensoryProfile.touch: A soft dry warmth off the brick end.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: The last link of the chain: the village's bread. Jaina's stomach turns over; she 'would not be eating bread for a while'.

establishedFacts.fact: The bakehouse takes all its flour from the granary next door; it bakes at cockcrow (Hob and Nan); Ellen carries the loaves out in a basket.
Shut and burned: 'All of the granary. All of the bakehouse' (Sylvanas, late night). The chimney stands cold at dawn.

eventsHere.event: Sylvanas questions Hob (finger-count of loads); the oven shut; at dawn Hob stands with a fork in the yard.
